allowed_evidence: Committed source and committed provenance/accounting contracts.
The cycle-1 terminal attempt error, stage, loader flag, exit code, and blind artifact hashes only.
No cycle-1 partial scientific metrics, plots, verdicts, or score-bearing output values.

allowed_repair_surface.implementation: The minimum local artifact-schema, manifest creation/validation ordering, or provenance consistency correction required for the frozen successful scientific computation to complete artifact finalization.
verification: Regression proving manifest creation precedes manifest-required schema validation.
Machine-readable semantic-diff audit proving every scientific computation path is equivalent to cycle-1 freeze.
Machine-readable proof that no failed-cycle scientific output was inspected or reused.

autonomous_successor_cycle_policy.next_cycle_order: Freeze the failed cycle, create and non-force push a distinct successor preregistration in a fresh namespace, then diagnose and repair.
autonomous_successor_cycle_policy.next_cycle_trigger: Any engineering or local provenance, schema, accounting, or test failure that does not require changing scientific definitions.
stop_conditions: scientific definitions or evaluation criteria require alteration
leakage or provenance cannot be preserved

canonical_protected_invocation.fresh_output_rule: No protected invocation or partial scientific output may exist in this cycle namespace before the canonical command.
canonical_protected_invocation.implementation_sha_rule: The substitution resolves exactly once to clean local HEAD equal to the pushed cycle-2 implementation freeze and origin branch SHA.

forbidden_changes: inspection or reuse of cycle-1 partial scientific metrics, plots, verdicts, or score-bearing outputs
mutation of cycle-1 outputs after terminal record creation
mutation of protected main or predecessor worktrees

predecessor_binding.failure_stage: _validate_required_outputs after protected analysis artifacts were generated and before finalize_manifest
